title: What If Everyone Worked Four Days a Week?

scenes.text: What if everyone worked four days a week? A real trial already ran the experiment.
In 2022, 61 UK companies and about 2,900 workers cut hours by 20 percent for six months, with no pay cut.
At the end, 71 percent of employees reported less burnout.
Staff leaving fell 57 percent, and sick days dropped 65 percent.
Revenue barely changed. Among 23 firms that shared figures, it rose 1.4 percent on average.
56 of the 61 companies planned to keep it, and 18 made it permanent.

description:
What if everyone worked four days a week?
In a UK trial of 61 companies, burnout fell, staff turnover dropped 57 percent and 92 percent of firms kept the change.
What should we run through next?
